description: Fix: play button state and blank preview after 'models still generating' toast

bugs.title: Play button fires during script_ready with no user warning
bugs.root_cause: assetsReady was false and the button was no-op (⏳ icon), but user had no way to play even though the game script was ready. No affordance existed for the script_ready window.
changes: Added assetsProgress state ({done, total}) updated during build polling's script_ready phase
Added showPlayModal state to gate the PlayAnywayModal
Play button now has 3 distinct states: isBuilding → disabled (⏳), !assetsReady && !isBuilding → amber (▶, shows X/Y label), assetsReady → green (▶ Play)
Added PlayAnywayModal component: shows progress, 'Play Now' (launches immediately) and 'Wait for Full Models' buttons
setShowPlayModal(false) and setAssetsProgress reset on status=done so modal auto-closes when models finish

bugs.title: Preview goes blank when play is rejected by Unity toast
bugs.root_cause: GameLauncher.PlayFromEditorAsync() called LuauGameRunner.ExitGame() at the very top of the method, before fetching game data or doing any validation. The bad assetUrlsJson guard then fired, showed a toast, and returned — leaving the preview destroyed with nothing replacing it.
changes: Moved LuauGameRunner.ExitGame() to AFTER all validation — only called when the launch is confirmed
Moved StatusBarManager.Hide() and EnterGameOrientationAsync() to after validation
Removed ShowLoadingOverlay/HideOverlay (not needed for a fast local API call)
Removed the bad assetUrlsJson == '{}' guard entirely — a game with no Meshy models legitimately has an empty manifest and should play normally
Failed validation now just shows a toast; the preview scene is never touched

test_cases.scenario: New world — AI says ready, user taps play during script_ready
test_cases.expected: Amber play button tapped → PlayAnywayModal appears over intact preview. 'Wait' dismisses modal. 'Play Now' launches game.

test_cases.scenario: New world — play tapped during isBuilding (pending)
test_cases.expected: Play button is ⏳ color=secondary, tap does nothing. No modal, no change.

test_cases.scenario: Game with no Meshy assets (assetsUrlsJson = '{}') — status = done
test_cases.expected: Play launches immediately with no toast. Preview transitions to game.

test_cases.scenario: Meshy models finish while PlayAnywayModal is open
test_cases.expected: Modal auto-closes (setShowPlayModal(false) at done). Play button turns green.

test_cases.scenario: Play tapped when gameCode is null/empty
test_cases.expected: Toast: 'This game has no script yet.' Preview stays intact.
